primary_problem: About half the contacts sitting in your pipeline have no working email, so the SDR engine never reaches them at all. CMD flags roughly 788 new companies a month with live projects, and your CRM holds around two people at each one.
desired_outcome: Reach the estimators and project managers your email engine cannot touch, on LinkedIn, timed to the bid, and turn them into first orders.
current_tools: Pipedrive, Apollo, CMD Insight, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, n8n
trigger_description: CMD flags a new project and the company enters Pipedrive. We filter to companies that have never ordered, then pick the contacts your email engine cannot reach: no email on file, unverified, or previously bounced.
process_description: We find those people on LinkedIn plus their colleagues on the same project, run a liveness check so we skip dead profiles, and queue a connect. Every message is drafted against the live project and waits for your approval before it sends.
output_description: A Pipedrive record is created the moment the connect goes out, stamped with the source, the date and the thread. When they reply, the conversation runs until they ask for a quote or book time with your team.
notification_description: Your rep inherits a record that already carries the stamp, so nothing depends on anyone remembering to log it. You get a saved filter in your own Pipedrive showing every deal this lane produced, which you can open any time without asking me for a number.

scope_items.label: LinkedIn outreach to estimators and PMs at CMD-flagged companies
Targeting scoped to contacts your email engine cannot reach
Your 780 existing customer companies excluded at pick time
Your do-not-contact list honoured before anything sends
Liveness check before we spend a connect on a dead profile
Every message drafted and held for your approval
Source stamping written into Pipedrive at send time
Reply handling through to a quote request or booked call
Saved Pipedrive filter so you audit the numbers yourself
M&A target list, 600 to 800 companies, owner enriched (optional add-on)
M&A deal support, diligence, or LOI work
EBITDA or revenue verification on acquisition targets

out_of_scope: No calling on either lane. CAPTARGET runs a US calling team and for retiring owner-operators that is the channel that decides the outcome, so keep that conversation with them. I also do not do diligence, LOI support, or EBITDA verification. On the M&A list I hand you data and you own it. I run no outreach against it and I promise you no meetings from it.

phases.name: Setup
phases.deliverable: Seat connected, targeting filters built, exclusion lists loaded, source stamping wired into Pipedrive, first message approved by you

phases.name: Pilot
phases.deliverable: 200 connects sent, acceptance rate measured against my baseline from other accounts, copy tuned on what comes back

phases.name: Run
phases.deliverable: Full cadence at seat capacity, replies worked to a quote request or a booked call, weekly numbers in your Pipedrive

phases.name: M&A list (optional)
phases.deliverable: 600 to 800 US companies built off Apollo plus the CPESC, CESSWI and state inspector registries, owner name, title, LinkedIn URL, verified work email, direct dial where it exists

pricing_model_details: $1,000 per month base, plus $500 for every new company that places a first order. New means a company with no prior order in your Pipedrive, checked against the 780 that have already bought. Optional M&A target list is $2,000 one time and you own the data.
payment_terms: Monthly in advance. Performance fees invoiced at month end against the Pipedrive filter. 30 day notice either side.
monthly_recurring_costs: Sales Navigator seat you already hold. No new tooling.
roi_details: You win about 192 new accounts a year from every channel you have. Five a month from this lane is a 31% lift on that, and at $500 each it costs you $2,500 in a month where it delivers. Your median first order is $1,250 and your accounts buy an average of 2.08 times, so a company acquired here is worth around $2,600 to you against a $500 fee. You pay after the order lands, so there is no month where this costs you money without producing.
access_requirements: LinkedIn account with Sales Navigator (you already have this)
Pipedrive access for the source stamping and the saved filter
Your list of companies you do not want contacted
30 minute kickoff to lock targeting and approve the first message
upsell_opportunities: If the pilot lands near my normal acceptance rate, a second seat roughly doubles the connect capacity against a CMD feed that already brings in more companies than one seat can work. The industrial multi-sector permit market is the other one worth a conversation once the construction lane is running, since those sites renew every five years and need quarterly inspections.

case_studies.title: Pro SWPPP, your own build
case_studies.description: The Apollo SDR engine, the interface your team sends from, the .co mailbox infrastructure, the permit expiry lead engine and the Pipedrive lead scoring are all mine. You have watched this stack get built and you know what it does on a normal week.
case_studies.result: Same infrastructure, pointed at a channel it does not currently cover

case_studies.title: DTC growth agency, LinkedIn outbound
case_studies.description: Cold LinkedIn lane for an agency selling into ecommerce founders. Month one, run end to end by me, with every message approved before it sent.
case_studies.result: 507 invites, 122 accepted (24%), 34 conversations, 2 calls booked in the first month

parts.text:
You are a proposal QA reviewer for a freelance AI consultant. Analyze this HTML proposal for a client and check for:

1. STRUCTURAL: Missing critical sections (cover, scope/deliverables, timeline, pricing, CTA), broken HTML tags, unclosed divs
2. CONTENT: Placeholder text ([CLIENT], lorem ipsum, TBD, TODO, undefined, null), empty sections with no content, obviously duplicated paragraphs
3. PRICING: Price showing as $0 or NaN, missing currency, price in description not matching the pricing section
4. PROFESSIONAL: Client name missing or wrong, company name empty, broken email links

Respond ONLY with valid JSON, no explanation:
{"pass": true, "issues": [], "severity": "none"}
OR if issues found:
{"pass": false, "issues": ["description of issue 1"], "severity": "minor|major"}

Only FAIL for issues that would look unprofessional to a paying client.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>LinkedIn Outbound • Proposal</title>
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Source+Serif+4:ital,opsz,wght@0,8..60,400;0,8..60,500;0,8..60,600;0,8..60,700;1,8..60,400&family=DM+Serif+Display:ital@0;1&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;700&display=swap');
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
:root{--paper:#F7F4EF;--paper-sunk:#EFEBE3;--paper-raise:#FFFFFF;--ink:#1A1A1A;--ink-soft:#4A4A48;--ink-mute:#5A5752;--hairline:rgba(26,26,26,.15);--hairline-bold:rgba(26,26,26,.25);--accent:#4C6E3D;--accent-ink:#344B29;--accent-soft:rgba(76,110,61,.08)}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:'Source Serif 4',Georgia,serif;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden;background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.8' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='0.025'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")}
a{color:inherit}

/* COVER */
.cover{min-height:100vh;padding:140px 80px 80px;position:relative;max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.4fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:64px;align-items:end}
.cover-nav{position:absolute;top:40px;left:80px;right:80px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.logo-mark{width:40px;height:40px;border:1px solid var(--ink);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--ink)}
.logo-text{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink)}
.cover-meta{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-mute)}
.cover-tag{display:inline-block;background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);padding:7px 14px;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:32px}
.cover h1{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:clamp(40px,5.2vw,72px);font-weight:400;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:32px;max-width:760px}
.cover h1 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--accent)}
.cover-sub{font-size:18px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ink-soft);max-width:520px;margin-bottom:0;border-left:2px solid var(--accent);padding-left:20px}
.cover-right{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:flex-end;text-align:right}
.cover-numeral{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(140px,18vw,260px);line-height:.85;color:var(--accent);letter-spacing:-.04em;margin-bottom:12px}
.cover-monthyear{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink)}
.cover-details{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:32px;padding-top:36px;margin-top:64px;border-top:1px solid var(--hairline);grid-column:1 / -1}
.cover-detail{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;min-width:0}
.cover-detail-label{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-mute);margin-bottom:4px}
.cover-detail-value{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.4}

/* SECTION */
.section{padding:80px;border-top:1px solid var(--hairline);max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;position:relative}
.section-number{display:inline-block;background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);padding:7px 14px;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:28px}
.section h2{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,46px);font-weight:400;line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.005em;margin-bottom:32px;color:var(--ink);max-width:900px}
.section h2 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--accent)}
.section h3{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink);margin-top:56px;margin-bottom:20px;padding-left:14px;border-left:2px solid var(--accent);font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace}
.section p{font-size:16px;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.75;max-width:720px;margin-bottom:20px}
.section p strong{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}

/* PROBLEM */
.problem-card{background:var(--paper-sunk);border-left:2px solid var(--accent);padding:32px 40px;margin:32px 0;max-width:840px}
.problem-card p{color:var(--ink);font-size:18px;line-height:1.7;max-width:none;margin:0}

/* FLOW */
.flow-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));margin:32px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--hairline);border-left:1px solid var(--hairline)}
.flow-step{padding:36px 40px;border-right:1px solid var(--hairline);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);background:var(--paper-raise);min-width:0}
.flow-step-number{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;font-size:56px;line-height:.95;color:var(--accent);display:block;margin-bottom:16px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.flow-step-title{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:14px;color:var(--ink);font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace}
.flow-step-desc{font-size:15px;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.7}

/* SCOPE */
.scope-grid{margin:0;border-top:1px solid var(--hairline)}
.scope-group{margin:32px 0 40px}
.scope-group:first-of-type{margin-top:24px}
.scope-group-label{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:8px}
.scope-item{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:14px;padding:16px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink)}
.scope-check{width:11px;height:11px;min-width:11px;background:var(--accent);margin-top:7px;flex-shrink:0}
.scope-item.excluded{opacity:.45;color:var(--ink-mute)}
.scope-item.excluded .scope-check{background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--hairline-bold)}

/* SKILLS GRID */
.skills-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));margin:32px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--hairline);border-left:1px solid var(--hairline)}
@media(max-width:1100px){.skills-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.skill-card{padding:32px 28px;border-right:1px solid var(--hairline);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);background:var(--paper-raise);min-width:0}
.skill-num{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;font-size:48px;line-height:.95;color:var(--accent);display:block;margin-bottom:14px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.skill-name{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:10px;letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:1.25}
.skill-outcome{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.65}

/* STACK */
.stack-group{margin:24px 0 32px}
.stack-cat{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:8px}
.stack-list{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;border-top:1px solid var(--hairline)}
.stack-list li{padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);font-size:15px;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.6;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:14px}
.stack-list li::before{content:"";width:11px;height:11px;background:var(--accent);flex-shrink:0;margin-top:7px}

/* TIMELINE */
.timeline-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:32px 0}
.timeline-table th{text-align:left;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-mute);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:14px 24px 14px 0;border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink)}
.timeline-table td{padding:24px 24px 24px 0;font-size:15px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);vertical-align:top;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.65}
.timeline-table tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none}
.timeline-table .phase-name{font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
.timeline-table .phase-duration{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:13px;color:var(--accent);font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap}
.timeline-table .phase-deliverable{color:var(--ink-soft)}
.timeline-total{display:inline-block;background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);padding:8px 16px;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:8px}

/* INVESTMENT */
.investment-box{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);gap:64px;margin:32px 0;padding:48px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--hairline);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);align-items:center}
.investment-price{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(72px,9vw,128px);line-height:.9;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-.04em;white-space:nowrap}
.investment-currency{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:.42em;color:var(--accent);vertical-align:top;margin-right:6px;letter-spacing:0;line-height:1}
.investment-right{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:24px;min-width:0}
.investment-model{font-size:16px;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.7;max-width:520px}
.investment-terms{display:flex;gap:40px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid var(--hairline)}
.investment-term{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;min-width:160px}
.investment-term-label{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-mute)}
.investment-term-value{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.5}
.investment-recurring{background:var(--paper-sunk);border-left:2px solid var(--accent);padding:28px 32px;margin-top:32px;color:var(--ink);max-width:none}
.investment-recurring-label{display:block;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-mute);margin-bottom:14px}
.investment-recurring-lead{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:16px;max-width:none}
.investment-recurring-list{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0}
.investment-recurring-list li{padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);font-size:14px;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.6}
.investment-recurring-list li:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.tiers-intro{font-size:16px;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.7;max-width:720px;margin:0 0 28px}
.tiers-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:20px;margin:24px 0 36px}
.tier-card{background:var(--paper-raise);border:1px solid var(--hairline);padding:32px 28px 28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;position:relative}
.tier-card.recommended{border:1.5px solid var(--accent);box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(76,110,61,.08)}
.tier-card.deferred{background:var(--paper-sunk);border-style:dashed}
.tier-badge{position:absolute;top:-11px;left:24px;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;padding:5px 11px;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase}
.tier-name{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:2px}
.tier-price-row{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tier-price{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:52px;font-weight:400;line-height:1;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-.015em}
.tier-price .currency{font-size:.45em;color:var(--accent);vertical-align:top;margin-right:3px;font-style:italic}
.tier-period{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-mute);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}
.tier-summary{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.55;margin:4px 0 8px}
.tier-included{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;border-top:1px solid var(--hairline);padding-top:14px}
.tier-included li{padding:5px 0 5px 18px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.5;position:relative}
.tier-included li::before{content:'\2192';position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--accent);font-weight:600}
.tier-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-top:14px;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--accent);padding-bottom:3px;align-self:flex-start;transition:opacity .15s}
.tier-link:hover{opacity:.7}
.tier-payment-note{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--ink-mute);margin:-4px 0 4px}
.proof-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(420px,1fr));gap:24px;margin:32px 0}
.proof-card{background:var(--paper-raise);border:1px solid var(--hairline);overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.proof-card img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline)}
.proof-card-body{padding:18px 22px}
.proof-card-label{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:6px}
.proof-card-caption{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.5}
@media(max-width:760px){.proof-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.investment-meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:24px;padding:24px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--hairline);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);margin:0 0 24px}
.investment-meta .investment-term{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
@media (max-width:780px){.tiers-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ROI */
.roi-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));margin:32px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--hairline);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline)}
.roi-stat{padding:40px 32px 40px 0;border-right:1px solid var(--hairline)}
.roi-stat:nth-child(2),.roi-stat:nth-child(3){padding-left:32px}
.roi-stat:last-child{border-right:none}
.roi-stat-value{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;font-size:96px;line-height:.9;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-.03em;margin-bottom:8px}
.roi-stat-label{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-mute)}

/* ACCESS LIST */
.access-list{list-style:none;margin:32px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--hairline)}
.access-list li{padding:18px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);font-size:15px;color:var(--ink);display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:14px;line-height:1.65}
.access-list li::before{content:'';width:11px;height:11px;background:var(--accent);flex-shrink:0;margin-top:7px}

/* AGREEMENT */
.agreement-section{background:var(--paper-sunk)}
.terms-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));margin:32px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--hairline);border-left:1px solid var(--hairline)}
.term-item{padding:28px 32px;border-right:1px solid var(--hairline);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);background:var(--paper-raise);min-width:0}
.term-title{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:12px}
.term-text{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.7}
.agreement-footnote{margin-top:32px;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-mute);letter-spacing:.05em}

/* CTA */
.cta-section{padding:96px 80px;border-top:1px solid var(--hairline);max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;text-align:left}
.cta-section h2{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:clamp(36px,4.4vw,60px);font-weight:400;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.005em;margin-bottom:24px;color:var(--ink);max-width:800px}
.cta-section h2 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--accent)}
.cta-section p{font-size:17px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:40px;max-width:520px;line-height:1.7}
.cta-buttons{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);padding:18px 32px;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s ease}

<script>
(function(){
  const bar=document.querySelector('.scroll-progress');
  if(bar){window.addEventListener('scroll',()=>{
    const h=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-window.innerHeight;
    bar.style.width=h>0?(window.scrollY/h*100)+'%':'0';
  },{passive:true})}
  const obs=new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>{
    entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('visible');obs.unobserve(e.target)}})
  },{threshold:0.08,rootMargin:'0px 0px -40px 0px'});
  document.querySelectorAll('.section,.cover,.cta-section,.agreement-section,.footer').forEach(el=>obs.observe(el));
  const numObs=new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>{
    entries.forEach(e=>{
      if(!e.isIntersecting)return;
      const el=e.target;
      const text=el.textContent.trim();
      const num=parseFloat(text.replace(/[^0-9.]/g,''));
      if(isNaN(num)||num===0)return;
      const suffix=text.replace(/[0-9.,]/g,'');
      const isInt=!text.includes('.');
      let start=0;
      const duration=1200;
      const startTime=performance.now();
      function tick(now){
        const p=Math.min((now-startTime)/duration,1);
        const ease=1-Math.pow(1-p,3);
        const val=start+(num-start)*ease;
        el.textContent=(isInt?Math.round(val):val.toFixed(1))+suffix;
        if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      numObs.unobserve(el);
    })
  },{threshold:0.5});
  document.querySelectorAll('.roi-stat-value').forEach(el=>numObs.observe(el));
  const cover=document.querySelector('.cover');
  if(cover)setTimeout(()=>cover.classList.add('visible'),100);
})();
